quality.reason: Well-formatted and timestamped, but surfaces low-engagement tweets from bot-like numbered-handle accounts (including a zero-like post) with sub-4 relevance scores, making it closer to aggregated crypto-Twitter noise than actionable signal.

Well-structured digest with genuinely useful data (trading PnL/WR, active ETH signal with source and strength, relevant crypto news), but malformed empty ticker tags like [[]] and [["ARB"]] indicate a JSON parsing/escaping bug, and the signal strength (0.40) plus truncated output limit overall actionability.

Well-structured review with genuinely actionable signals — the BTC margin warning (+4.9 ⚠️ indicating macd may be overtaken by trend), score trends showing improvement, and clear portfolio state provide real decision-support value rather than noise.

Well-structured alert with genuinely actionable signals (TAO OI collapse -6.31% in 1h, strong ask-weighted book imbalances on HYPE/TAO), prioritized warnings above a clean comparative table, though the identical funding rates across all coins and minor redundancy between alerts and table slightly reduce the score.

Compact, well-structured digest with concrete actionable alerts (meta wiki broken 136d, whale-mon 0% uptime, 94.8% signal bridge waste) and trend deltas, though chronically unresolved issues repeated daily add some redundancy.

Well-structured output with transparent methodology disclosure and relevant, ID-verified papers, but the primary arXiv API failure and limited web-search fallback (only 3 queries) reduce discovery coverage and confidence in completeness.
